Set up libraries,

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include : FALSE


library(tidyverse) #data library
library(deSolve) #ODE solver
library(patchwork) #figure arrangement
library(dplyr) #data wrangling

```

Source needed functions,

```{r}
#| label: source
#| include : FALSE


source("R/IndependentThreePool.R")
source("R/OnePool_ODE.R")

```

and we're ready to go!

We have to set up our parameters - We'll use a simplified version of CENTURY model parameters, where the fast pool decays at a rate of 0.5-1 year, the slow pool at a rate of 10-50 years, and the passive pool at rates of 1000-5000 years.

This successfully has our pools at different orders of magnitude.

We also set up our input function (for this figure we will assume constant inputs).
Generally, we'll run the simulation to 500 years, as we are primarily interested in showing how this works across orders of magnitude of time in the future. 
Our argument is that this strategy works for time scales on the order of our middle pool - around 50 years (so generally between 10 and 100 years).

```{r}
#| Parameters
#| echo: FALSE

Params_IndThreePool.ls <- list(
                  ##Input-based parameters (such as allocation)
                  ave_inputs = 260,
                        #CENUTRY model uses 260 grams C per m^2 per year
                        #u; kg-carbon m-2 yr-1,
                    input_1 = 0.65,
                    input_2 = 0.325,

                  ##turnover times (years)
  
                     turnoverTime_1 = 1, #based on recent DAYCENT papers
                     turnoverTime_2 = 50, #adjusted, CENTURY 1987 has ~263, CENTURY 1983 has 50
                     turnoverTime_3 = 1500 #adjusted, CENTURY 1987 has ~7690, CENTURY 1983 has 1500 years
  )


Params_IndThreePool.ls$input_3 <- 1- Params_IndThreePool.ls$input_1 - Params_IndThreePool.ls$input_2

constant.fn <- function(time, parms){
  return(parms$ave_inputs)
}

#Simulation Times vector
SimTimes <- seq(0, 5e3, by = 1/12)

Params_IndThreePool.ls$inputs.fn <- constant.fn

Params_IndThreePool.ls
```


We'll consider a disturbed system at two-thirds its steady state values for initial state.


```{r}
#| label: Three-pool forward run

IndThreePool_InitialValue <- 2/3*c(
  Cumulative_Respiration = 0,
  Soil_1 = Params_IndThreePool.ls$ave_inputs * Params_IndThreePool.ls$input_1 * Params_IndThreePool.ls$turnoverTime_1,
  Soil_2 = Params_IndThreePool.ls$ave_inputs * Params_IndThreePool.ls$input_2 * Params_IndThreePool.ls$turnoverTime_2,
  Soil_3 = Params_IndThreePool.ls$ave_inputs * Params_IndThreePool.ls$input_3 * Params_IndThreePool.ls$turnoverTime_3
  )

IndThreePool_Sim.df <- lsoda(y = IndThreePool_InitialValue,
                times = SimTimes,
                func = IndThreePool_ODE.fn,
                parms = Params_IndThreePool.ls) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  select(!c(Cumulative_Respiration)) %>%
  mutate(Respiration_Rate = IndThreePool_ODE.fn(t = NA, 
                                           y = c(NA, Soil_1, Soil_2, Soil_3),
                                           parms = Params_IndThreePool.ls
                            )[[1]]['Cumulative_Respiration'],
          .by = everything()
    )

###We're not interested in specific numbers, so we're going to normalize this to a the three-pool steady state
ThreePoolSS <- with(Params_IndThreePool.ls,
                    ave_inputs * (turnoverTime_1*input_1 +  (turnoverTime_2*input_2) + (turnoverTime_3*input_3))
)

##Spits out a graph for initial verification
Stacked3.gr <- ggplot(IndThreePool_Sim.df %>% pivot_longer(cols = Soil_1:Soil_3,
                               names_to = "Pool",
                               values_to = "Mass")) + 
  geom_area(aes(x=time, y=Mass/ThreePoolSS, fill=Pool)) + 
  #facet_wrap(~ Pool, ncol=1, scales='free') + 
  labs(title = "Three Pool forward run", x = "Time (years)", y = "Soil Carbon (portion of steady state)") 

##Spits out a graph for initial verification
Faceted3.gr <- ggplot(IndThreePool_Sim.df %>% pivot_longer(cols = Soil_1:Soil_3,
                               names_to = "Pool",
                               values_to = "Mass")) + 
  geom_line(aes(x=time, y=Mass/ThreePoolSS)) + 
  facet_wrap(~ Pool, ncol=1, scales='free') + 
  labs(title = "Three Pool forward run", x = "log_10 Time (years)", y = "Soil Carbon (portion of total steady state)") + scale_x_log10()

Faceted3.gr + Stacked3.gr

```

We'll convert these params and initial value into a new ODE... and see what happens!

```{r}
#| label: One-pool forward run

#Create a function that turns an independent three-pool parameterization into one-pool model parameters

IndpendentRCM_OnePool_params.fn <- function(Initial_Value,
                             Parms){
 New_Parms <- list(
                  ##Input parameter
                  ave_inputs = (1/Parms$turnoverTime_2)* #decay times...
                    ( #...the sum of...
                      (Parms$ave_inputs * Parms$input_1 * Parms$turnoverTime_1) +     #...steady state of the fast pool,
                        (Parms$ave_inputs * Parms$input_2 * Parms$turnoverTime_2) +   #... steady state of the slow pool,
                        Initial_Value[4]                                              #...and the initial value of the Passive pool.
                      ),
                  ##Inputs function
                  inputs.fn = Parms$inputs.fn,
                  ##turnover time (years)
                  turnoverTime = Parms$turnoverTime_2
                  
  )
    
    
  return(New_Parms = New_Parms)
}

##Function that takes the initial value and parameters and spits out a new one-pool initial value
IndpendentRCM_OnePool_IV.fn <- function(Initial_Value,
                             Parms){

  New_IV <- (Parms$ave_inputs * Parms$input_1 * Parms$turnoverTime_1) + Initial_Value["Soil_2"] + Initial_Value["Soil_3"]
  #Initial Values are retained for pool of interest and for slower pools, faster pools are considered to start at their steady state.
  
  
  return(New_Initial_Value = c(Cumulative_Respiration = 0,
                          Soil_Carbon_Concentration = unname(New_IV)
                          )
  )
}
 

Params_IndRCM.ls <- IndpendentRCM_OnePool_params.fn(Initial_Value = IndThreePool_InitialValue,
                                                    Parms = Params_IndThreePool.ls)

IndRCM_InitialValue <- IndpendentRCM_OnePool_IV.fn(Initial_Value = IndThreePool_InitialValue,
                                                   Parms = Params_IndThreePool.ls)


IndRCM_Sim.df <- lsoda(y = IndRCM_InitialValue,
                times = SimTimes,
                func = OnePool_ODE.fn,
                parms = Params_IndRCM.ls) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  select(!c(Cumulative_Respiration)) %>%
  mutate(Respiration_Rate = OnePool_ODE.fn(t = NA, 
                                           y = c(NA, Soil_Carbon_Concentration),
                                           parms = Params_IndRCM.ls
                            )[[1]]['Cumulative_Respiration'],
          .by = everything()
    )

###As before, we're not interested in specific numbers, so we're going to normalize this to a this model's steady state
RCMSS <- sum(with(Params_IndThreePool.ls,
                    ave_inputs * (turnoverTime_1*input_1 +  turnoverTime_2*input_2)
),
                  IndThreePool_InitialValue["Soil_3"]
)


# ##Spits out a graph for initial verification
IndRCM.gr <- ggplot(IndRCM_Sim.df) +
  geom_line(aes(x=time, y=Soil_Carbon_Concentration/RCMSS)) +
  labs(title = "Independent Reduced Complexity forward run", x = "log_10 Time (years)", y = "Soil Carbon (portion of steady state)") + scale_x_log10()

IndRCM.gr

```


Now, we compare.
Recall, our argument only applies for timescales on the order of magnitude of our middle pool (in this example).
So we expect that if we start slicing timescales, this will be very different.

```{r}

Comparison.df <- rbind(IndRCM_Sim.df %>% mutate(Model = "RCM") %>%
        select(c(time, Soil_Carbon_Concentration, Model)),
      IndThreePool_Sim.df %>% mutate(Soil_Carbon_Concentration = Soil_1 + Soil_2 + Soil_3,
                                     Model = "Ind3") %>%
        select(c(time, Soil_Carbon_Concentration, Model))
)

Logtime.gr <- ggplot(Comparison.df) +# %>% filter(time <= 100) %>% filter(time >= 10)) +
  geom_line(aes(x=time, y=Soil_Carbon_Concentration/ThreePoolSS, linetype=Model)) +
  #scale_linetype_manual(values = c("solid", "dotdash"))+
  scale_linetype_discrete(labels = c("Ind. 3-pool model", "Reduced Complexity Model"))+
  labs(title = "Multi-pool Independent vs Reduced Complexity Model", 
       x = "Time (years)", 
       y = "Soil Carbon (% of steady state)") +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::comma) +
  annotate("rect", fill = "red", alpha = 0.5, 
        xmin = 10, xmax = 100,
        ymin = 0.68, ymax = 0.78) +
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        #legend.frame = element_rect(colour = "black",
        #                           linewidth = 1),
        legend.background = element_rect(color = "black", fill = "white"),
        legend.frame = element_rect(color = "black"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        text = element_text(size = 7),
        title = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 6)
        ) 

Zoomed_in.gr <- ggplot(Comparison.df %>% filter(time <= 100) %>% filter(time >= 10)) +
  geom_line(aes(x=time, y=Soil_Carbon_Concentration/ThreePoolSS, linetype=Model)) +
  labs(#title = "Independent Reduced Complexity forward run comparisons", 
       x = "Time (years)", 
       y = "Soil Carbon") +
  scale_y_continuous(position = "right") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "red", 
                                    fill=NA, 
                                    linewidth=1),
        text = element_text(size = 6))

# #Full sim graph with time not transformed by log10 
# ggplot(Comparison.df) +# %>% filter(time <= 100) %>% filter(time >= 10)) +
#   geom_line(aes(x=time, y=Soil_Carbon_Concentration/ThreePoolSS, linetype=Model)) +
#   labs(title = "Independent Reduced Complexity forward run comparisons", x = "Time (years)", y = "Soil Carbon (% of steady state)")

Logtime.gr + inset_element(Zoomed_in.gr, 
                            left = 0.05,
                            bottom = 0.45,
                            right = 0.6,
                            top = 1
                           ) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 6))

ggsave(
  "IndependentRCM.pdf",
  device = "pdf",
  path = "Figures/",
  width = 8.7,
  height = 9,
  units = "cm",
  dpi = "retina"
)

```

# Pulling some numbers.

```{r}
Difference.df <- Comparison.df %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Model,
              values_from = Soil_Carbon_Concentration) %>%
  mutate(Difference = abs(Ind3-RCM)) %>%
  mutate(SSNormalizedDifference = (Difference/sum(ThreePoolSS))*100,
         Ind3NormalizedDifference = (Difference/Ind3)*100) 

Difference.df %>%
  filter(time %in% c(0.5, 10, 20, 30, 50, 100, 1000, 10000)) %>%
  mutate(Error = paste(round(Ind3NormalizedDifference,2), "%")) %>%
  select(c("time", "Error")) 

ggplot(Difference.df) + 
  geom_line(aes(x = time, y = Ind3NormalizedDifference)) +
  scale_x_log10() + 
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        #legend.frame = element_rect(colour = "black",
        #                           linewidth = 1),
        legend.background = element_rect(color = "black", fill = "white"),
        legend.frame = element_rect(color = "black"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        text = element_text(size = 7),
        title = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 6)
        ) 
```





# OLD
The following was used to help me debunk an issue I was having and is now obsolete (though not incorrect).

```{r}
#| label: non-ODEs

Solution_OnePool <- tibble("time" = SimTimes,
                           "Carbon" = with(Params_IndThreePool.ls,
                                           (ave_inputs*input_1*turnoverTime_1)  + #first (fast) pool at steady state
                                            IndThreePool_InitialValue["Soil_3"] + #third (passive) pool at initial value
                                            #Solution for second (middle, 'slow') pool 
                                             (ave_inputs*input_2*turnoverTime_2 - #middle pool SS less...
                                               (ave_inputs*input_2*turnoverTime_2 - IndThreePool_InitialValue["Soil_2"]) * 
                                                exp(-SimTimes/turnoverTime_2)
                                               )
                                           )
)


Solution_ThreePool <- tibble("time" = SimTimes,
                           "Pool_1" = with(Params_IndThreePool.ls, 
                                           ave_inputs*input_1*turnoverTime_1 - 
                                               (ave_inputs*input_1*turnoverTime_1 - IndThreePool_InitialValue["Soil_1"]) * 
                                                exp(-SimTimes/turnoverTime_1)
                                               ),
                           "Pool_2" = with(Params_IndThreePool.ls, 
                                           ave_inputs*input_2*turnoverTime_2 - 
                                               (ave_inputs*input_2*turnoverTime_2 - IndThreePool_InitialValue["Soil_2"]) * 
                                                exp(-SimTimes/turnoverTime_2)
                                               ),
                           "Pool_3" = with(Params_IndThreePool.ls, 
                                           ave_inputs*input_3*turnoverTime_3 - 
                                               (ave_inputs*input_3*turnoverTime_3 - IndThreePool_InitialValue["Soil_3"]) * 
                                                exp(-SimTimes/turnoverTime_3)
                                               )
                           ) %>%
  mutate("Carbon" = Pool_1 + Pool_2 +Pool_3)


ggplot() + 
  geom_line(data = Solution_OnePool, aes(x=time, y=Carbon)) + 
  geom_line(data = Solution_ThreePool, aes(x=time, y=Carbon)) + 
  xlim(10,100)

```
